info.description: Problem on complement of a graph for densest k-subgraph problem.I.e. sparsest k-subgraph problem. Objective is modified as follows: x^TQx = 1/2*x^TA(complement(G))x - lambda*(sum(x)-k) + mu*(sum(x) - k)^2 Where: A is adjacency matrix, offset = lambda*k + mu*k^2
